Crispy sheet-pan gnocchi with cherry tomatoes & basil

Pillow-soft gnocchi roasted on a sheet pan until golden and crisp. Tossed with cherry tomatoes that burst in the oven to create a natural sauce. A hands-off approach that skips the boiling water.

Prep
5 min
Cook
20-25 min
Ingredients & Method ↓

Development edition · Awaits kitchen testing.

Ingredients Method Storage

Ingredients

How many people?
2

Estimated to serve 2 people as a comforting meal.

  • 1 package shelf-stable potato gnocchi
    Package size: 16 oz / 450 g.
  • 2 cups (300.0 g) cherry or grape tomatoes
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 2 garlic cloves, smashed
  • ½ tsp dried oregano
  • ½ tsp kosher salt
  • ¼ tsp black pepper
  • ½ cup fresh basil leaves, torn
  • 2 tbsp grated Parmesan or pecorino (optional)

Contains wheat (gnocchi). Contains milk if finished with cheese.

Method

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).

01

Heat the oven and prep pan.

Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.

02

Toss directly on the sheet.

Add the uncooked gnocchi, whole cherry tomatoes, and smashed garlic cloves directly onto the pan. Drizzle with olive oil, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Toss with hands until evenly glossy, spreading in a single layer.

03

Roast until golden and blistered.

Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, tossing once halfway through, until gnocchi are deeply golden and crisp on the edges and tomatoes have burst and released juices.

Look for: Gnocchi are golden and crispy on the edges, and tomatoes have burst.

04

Finish with basil and cheese.

Toss in the torn basil right on the hot sheet so it wilts slightly. Sprinkle with grated Parmesan and serve hot straight from the pan.

Serve with

Estimated to serve 2 people as a comforting meal.

One way to change it up

No basil? Baby arugula or spinach folded in hot adds fresh peppery greens. For extra protein, toss cooked chickpeas or sliced sausage onto the sheet.

A small technique note

Do not boil the gnocchi first! Roasting dry shelf-stable gnocchi directly in olive oil creates a delightful crispy skin with a pillowy interior.

Storage & Prep ahead

Keep at 40°F (4°C) or colder. Refrigerate within 2 hours of preparation, or within 1 hour above 90°F (32°C). Discard if left out longer. Storage life depends on ingredient freshness and preparation.
